Which Mod Organizer instance?

Point at the portable MO2 folder (the one with ModOrganizer.exe, mods\ and profiles\). The game is taken from its Stock Game folder.

Which worldspaces?

Only worldspaces with a lodsettings file can have LOD. Tamriel is the big one; the rest take seconds.

What to generate

DynDOLOD

Object LOD with DynDOLOD's rules and LOD models, plus dynamic LOD plugins and occlusion. Reads DynDOLOD's configuration from tools\DynDOLOD.

Earlier LOD output enabled in the profile (LODForge mods, DynDOLOD output) is not read.

Materials

PBR builds the pbr_lod texture twins and PBR texture sets from the textures\pbr\ sources. Standard writes plain textures only: LOD carries no complex-material or parallax maps, so this is what any non-PBR list gets.

Stages

Grass LOD

Grass Optimizations (Community Shaders) shows grass far out with NGIO's extended grass distance and swaps in these crossed-plane meshes; no grass cache is needed.

Seasons

Seasons need swap files in Data\Seasons. The default season is always built.
